rusted_blade.name: Rusted Blade
rusted_blade.description: A worn out blade, but still sharp enough.
rusted_blade.flavor_text: A blade tempered in the last Emberfall. It remembers the heat.

leather_vest.name: Leather Vest
leather_vest.flavor_text: Stitched by hands long since stilled. The leather still holds warmth.

healing_salve.name: Healing Salve
healing_salve.flavor_text: Pressed from moss that only grows where the Keepers once walked.

lucky_pendant.name: Lucky Pendant
lucky_pendant.description: A small charm that seems to bring good luck.
lucky_pendant.flavor_text: A keeper's sigil, worn smooth by centuries of prayer.
